profile.name: Joshua Agbeku
profile.tagline: SWE & SRE. I keep production boring so the product can be interesting.
profile.location: Ras Al Khaimah, United Arab Emirates
about: I'm a software and site reliability engineer with more than a decade in production IT, from running infrastructure at a national utility to supervising SRE for a payments platform serving the Ghanaian market.

I care about systems that fail gracefully, deploys that nobody has to babysit, and on-call rotations people can live with. Away from the day job I build products through Termite Tech Lab, including Keykad.

focus.title: Reliability
focus.body: SLOs, incident response, capacity and on-call design.

focus.title: Delivery
focus.body: CI/CD, infrastructure as code, safe and frequent releases.

focus.title: Observability
focus.body: Metrics, logs and traces that answer questions at 3am.

focus.title: Software
focus.body: Backend services and tooling, shipped and maintained.

experience.summary: Reliability and DevOps engineering for the UAE's first integrated resort, a $5.1B development on a 60-hectare island opening in 2027.
Supervised site reliability for a payments and commerce platform: availability, incident management and the engineering practices behind them.
Stepped up to senior responsibility for IT systems and user support across the organisation.
Seven years supporting infrastructure, systems and end users at a national utility, where I learned what uptime means to people.

ventures.name: Termite Tech Lab
ventures.summary: A software product development company building for businesses that already work: product engineering, modernisation and integration, payments and commerce infrastructure, and long-term engineering partnerships.

ventures.name: Keykad
ventures.summary: One flexible pass for gyms, studios, pools and more. Members buy prepaid credits via mobile money or card and spend them across venues; venue owners get paid per attended visit.
